title: Relative bicentralizers and modular spectral recovery

result.label: Relative bicentralizers and modular spectral recovery
result.statement: Proves Connes' bicentralizer conjecture for every type III 1 factor with separable predual and every faithful normal state. More generally, for every inclusion N M of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals admitting a faithful normal conditional expectation, constructs an amenable expected subalgebra P N with P' c(M)=N' c(M), resolving the relative bicentralizer conjecture.
